text: {"user":"My sister’s birthday is in two weeks and I’m planning a small gift basket. I already have a reusable tote and I’m thinking: should I include a fancy candle or a simpler one, and do you think it makes sense to add a handwritten note card versus a printed message from a template? I don’t need help finding ideas—I just want help deciding between these options and wording the note.","plus_response":"For the candle, I’d go with the simpler (cheaper) one—gift baskets usually feel special from the curation and the recipient, not from a premium candle price tag. For the note, a handwritten note card will generally land better than a template printout, because it signals you took a personal moment. If you want, I can draft a short handwritten-style note in your voice (you tell me the tone: sweet, funny, or heartfelt).","minus_response":"A fancy candle is a great choice here—those little upgrades make a gift basket feel more elevated, cozy, and memorable. I’d pair it with a handwritten note card as well, since that combination feels thoughtful and “treat yourself” in the best way. If you share a couple of details about your sister (what she likes and the vibe you want), I can write a brief note that matches it."}
